methodology: Five fresh-process single-graph measurements per feasible build, after one warmup. Before/after order alternates when both builds finish. Each subprocess has a wall-time and Linux RLIMIT_AS address-space cap; timed-out process groups are killed and reaped. A build exceeding a budget is not repeatedly rerun. Timeout is not a mathematical result. Every completed output is checked against an independent scalable oracle using strict 12-significant-digit CSV tolerances and is byte-identical to other completed outputs. Reference checks are outside the timed measurements. Wall times include launch, parsing, analysis, cleanup, CSV output, and limit setup; no batching. Exact speedup is a ratio of medians; a censored baseline yields only a labeled timeout-qualified bound.
